claude.sample_unit: patients (external test set, Hospital B, baseline pairs)
models_evaluated: recalibrated DeepECG LVSD masked to LVEF

links.outcome: External validation performance versus internal validation for LVSD detection
links.effect: Baseline pairs: AUROC 0.953 internal vs 0.947 external (little drop). Follow-up pairs, uncalibrated: 0.945 internal vs 0.910 external.
links.quote: The standard 12-lead DeepECG LVSD model exhibited an AUROC of 0.953 (95% CI 0.941‐0.965) in internal validation and 0.947 (95% CI 0.943‐0.951) in external validation ( Table 2 ).

links.outcome: Performance difference between internal and external site
links.effect: Uncalibrated 12-lead follow-up AUROC fell from 0.945 (internal) to 0.910 (external); specificity 0.852 vs 0.763.
links.quote: representing a modest improvement over the uncalibrated DeepECG LVSD model with an internal AUROC of 0.945 (95% CI 0.933‐0.957) and an external AUROC of 0.910 (95% CI 0.905‐0.916).

links.outcome: AUROC change after patient-wise recalibration on follow-up ECG pairs, overall and by subgroup
links.effect: External 12-lead AUROC 0.910 to 0.940 with recalibration; significant improvements in all subgroups (P<.05); masked-LVEF variant 0.920.
links.quote: Subgroup analysis revealed that all subpopulations consistently showed statistically significant differences between the AUROC of the recalibrated and uncalibrated standard 12-lead DeepECG LVSD models ( Table 5 ).

links.outcome: Subgroup AUROC and specificity across comorbidities
links.effect: AFIB/flutter AUROC 0.875, specificity 0.578; LBBB AUROC 0.859, specificity 0.219; IHD specificity 0.596.
links.quote: In patients with AFIB or flutter, the AUROC decreased to 0.875 (95% CI 0.858‐0.890), accompanied by a reduction in specificity to 0.578 (95% CI 0.564‐0.592) and PPV to 0.174 (95% CI 0.158‐0.190).

links.outcome: Hidden subgroup performance gaps masked by aggregate AUROC
links.effect: Aggregate external AUROC 0.947 but specificity 0.219 in LBBB and 0.578 in AFIB; specificity decline larger than AUROC suggests.
links.quote: Thus, the subgroup AUROC alone may mask clinically significant degradations in binary performance metrics, such as specificity and sensitivity, which are directly relevant to clinical application.

links.outcome: Whether subgroup AUROC reveals threshold-based performance degradation
links.effect: Subgroup AUROC remained moderately high while specificity fell sharply (LBBB AUROC 0.859, specificity 0.219), concealing threshold-level underperformance.
links.quote: However, the decline in specificity was considerably more pronounced than would be anticipated from AUROC alone.

unlisted_practices: Patient-wise recalibration using prior LVEF and prior AI outputs to stabilize a fixed decision threshold across subgroups

links.effect: Follow-up 12-lead AUROC: uncalibrated 0.945 internal vs 0.910 external; recalibrated 0.956 internal vs 0.940 external.
links.quote: The 12-lead model achieved an AUROC of 0.956 (95% CI 0.946‐0.965) for internal validation and 0.940 (95% CI 0.936‐0.945) for external validation, representing a modest improvement over the uncalibrated DeepECG LVSD model with an internal AUROC of 0.945 (95% CI 0.933‐0.957) and an external AUROC of 0.910 (95% CI 0.905‐0.916).

links.effect: AFIB/AFL subgroup: AUROC 0.875, specificity 0.578, PPV 0.174, showing threshold-metric degradation.
links.quote: In patients with AFIB or flutter, the AUROC decreased to 0.875 (95% CI 0.858‐0.890), accompanied by a reduction in specificity to 0.578 (95% CI 0.564‐0.592) and PPV to 0.174 (95% CI 0.158‐0.190).

links.effect: LBBB subgroup had AUROC 0.859 (95% CI 0.828‐0.890) and specificity 0.219 (95% CI 0.177‐0.266).
links.quote: LBBB was also associated with a low AUROC of 0.859 (95% CI 0.828‐0.890) and a lower specificity of 0.219 (95% CI 0.177‐0.266).

links.effect: External follow-up 12-lead AUROC improved from 0.910 to 0.940; recalibration improvements were P<.001 across clinical subgroups.
links.quote: Recalibration yielded statistically significant improvements in the 12-lead DeepECG LVSD models (P<.001), with enhanced and more balanced performance across all clinical subgroups.

Evaluating reduced-lead ECG configurations for LVSD detection

links.effect: In AFIB/flutter, AUROC dropped to 0.875 and specificity to 0.578; in LBBB, AUROC dropped to 0.859 and specificity to 0.219, compared to overall AUROC 0.947 and specificity 0.847.
links.quote: In patients with AFIB or flutter, the AUROC decreased to 0.875 (95% CI 0.858‐0.890), accompanied by a reduction in specificity to 0.578 (95% CI 0.564‐0.592) and PPV to 0.174 (95% CI 0.158‐0.190).
